Use case: illustration-story. Produce archer-c.png, a production animation sprite sheet for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0. Use attached master-side.png as the locked character design reference, not as a background. Canvas exactly 1536x1024 landscape with genuinely transparent background, real alpha.
Exactly EIGHT separate full-body drawings in TWO rows of FOUR, reading left to right. Four equal 384x512 cells per row, no visible cell borders. Keep all sprites inside their cells with transparent gaps, no overlap or cropping. Same anatomical scale across all eight frames (standing equivalent approximately 390 pixels high; horizontal poses retain the same body and bow lengths). Shared implied ground baseline at y=470 for top row and y=982 for bottom row. No floor or ground shadow.
Character precisely matches reference: lean adult man 25, narrow alert face, short brown beard and brown hair, white hood UP with face visible, white flowing cloak muddy brown at hem, golden sunburst on LEFT breast, brown leather jerkin and straps over grey chain mail, brown bracers, brown trousers and boots, white-fletched arrow quiver, short belt knife. Tall wooden longbow with recurved tips; maintain identical physical length and curvature throughout, rotate it as appropriate to fit each pose. No shield. Maintain design details even during falling and running.
House style exactly reference: hand-drawn HD 2D fighting-game art like Streets of Rage 4, confident dark brown near-black outlines thicker externally, clean 2–3-tone cel shading with subtle painterly gradients, rich grounded colors, soft upper-left key and gentle cool right rim. No pixel art, 3D, photorealism or chibi.
Top row:
1 (top left): KNOCKED BACK, enemy on left, face looking LEFT, launched backwards toward RIGHT, both feet airborne, body arching backward, startled face, holds bow.
2: FALLING, body nearly horizontal entirely ABOVE baseline, HEAD at RIGHT and boots at LEFT, back toward ground, continued backward fall, bow with him. Keep this horizontal pose compact via bent knees without changing body scale.
3: KNOCKED OUT, lying flat on back ON baseline, HEAD at RIGHT and boots at LEFT, eyes closed, peaceful unconscious kid-friendly expression. Longbow lies beside body along baseline, same length and curve, no blood or injury effects.
4: GET-UP, facing LEFT, down on one knee, one hand planted on ground, other hand grasping his bow, rising from unconscious pose.
Bottom row: four different consecutive FLEE run drawings, body facing RIGHT and moving RIGHT, each turns head back over shoulder to LEFT with scared expression, bow securely clutched in one hand tilted to fit cell, cloak streams behind to left. Frame 5 left boot forward and right boot back, long stride; frame 6 passing pose with rear leg lifting and knees close; frame 7 right boot forward and left boot back, opposing long stride; frame 8 next passing pose with opposite leg lifting, different from frame 6. Correct alternating running anatomy, no repeated or mirrored images.
Exactly two arms, two legs, two booted feet and anatomically correct five-fingered hands per character. Every frame a genuinely distinct drawing. Full head-to-boots visibility with margin. No text, labels, frame numbers, borders, dust, effects, motion lines or backgrounds. Actual transparent pixels around all figures.
